title: Njuɓɓudi E nder Julaaɓe
intro: Limre ina darii e yeeso leñol ngol luural njulaagu ñaami, ina noddira ɗum en nuunɗal e nuunɗal e nder golle mum en. Oo maccuɗo Alla jeertinii e rokkude peeje juutɗe e ustude peeje. Yimɓe ɓee njaɓaani heɗaade, ina ndartini riiwtude oo neɗɗo e leydi mum en. Leydi e hoore mum ummotoo ngam ñaawde ɓe. Hol ooɗoo limoore daraniinde nuunɗal e nder njulaagu ?
clues: Mi neldaama nulaaɗo e leñol luggiɗngol e njulaagu e njulaagu.
Leñol am rokkii peeje juutɗe nde teskaa marsandiis wonande woɗɓe.
Ɓe ndartinii kam riiwtude mi e leydi ndii so mi tiiɗnii e noddude ɓe e iimanaagal.
Miɗo siftortee ko miin ɓuri waawde haalde e nder annabaaɓe.
Yimɓe am nanngaa e yerɓo leydi bonngo, ngo addi ɓe nguurndam e nder galleeji maɓɓe.
Mi neldaama to yimɓe Madyanaaɓe to bannge worgo Hijaz.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Leñol am werlii ɗum e yiite ɓuuɓɗo
Faandaare ɗaɓɓaande feewnude gelooɗi debbo e haayre
Seedtiima halkere wuro am e konu maleykaaji

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Yimɓe am nanngaama e yerɓo leydi bonngo
Yimɓe am njippiima e ilam mawɗam
Mi hisnaama nde ngon-mi e nder reedu liɗɗi mawɗi
outcome.answer: Yimɓe am nanngaama e yerɓo leydi bonngo

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
verse: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!" (11:87)
